environment.description: Celery worker running in ECS Fargate task within private subnet. Tasks are dispatched by a Flask API gateway that accepts user profile sync requests. The API validates JWT tokens but passes the 'sub' claim and user-supplied 'department' field directly to the Celery task arguments. No input sanitization on task arguments. Redis broker accessible on internal network. LDAP server is Active Directory with anonymous read disabled but the service account has broad read access across the directory tree.

config.network: Private subnet, no WAF on internal task dispatch path
config.api_gateway: Flask app dispatches tasks via .delay() with raw user input
config.ldap_service_account_permissions: Read access to entire dc=corp,dc=local tree
config.rate_limiting: None on task dispatch or LDAP queries
config.input_validation: JWT signature verified but claims passed through unescaped
